title: Login with valid credentials
description: Verify that a registered user can log in using correct email and password.
preconditions: User account exists and is active.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page.
steps.expectedResult: Login form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter valid email and password, then click Sign In.
steps.expectedResult: User is redirected to the dashboard.

steps.action: Check the navigation bar for the user avatar.
steps.expectedResult: User name is displayed in the header.

title: Login with invalid password shows error
description: Verify that an incorrect password surfaces a clear error without revealing account existence.
preconditions: User account exists.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page.
steps.expectedResult: Login form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter valid email and a wrong password, then click Sign In.
steps.expectedResult: Error message 'Invalid email or password' is shown.

steps.action: Verify the password field is cleared.
steps.expectedResult: Password field is empty; email field retains value.

title: Two-factor authentication via SMS OTP
description: Verify that users with 2FA enabled must enter a valid OTP before accessing the account.
preconditions: User has 2FA enabled with a registered phone number.

steps.action: Log in with valid credentials.
steps.expectedResult: OTP entry screen is displayed.

steps.action: Enter the 6-digit OTP received via SMS.
steps.expectedResult: User is redirected to the dashboard.

steps.action: Attempt to use an expired OTP.
steps.expectedResult: Error: 'OTP has expired. Please request a new one.'

title: Session expires after 15 minutes of inactivity
description: Ensure the session is terminated automatically after the inactivity timeout.
preconditions: User is logged in.

steps.action: Log in and remain idle for 16 minutes.
steps.expectedResult: Session timeout modal appears at 14 minutes.

steps.action: Ignore the modal warning.
steps.expectedResult: User is logged out and redirected to the login page.

steps.action: Attempt to navigate to the dashboard directly.
steps.expectedResult: User is redirected to login.

title: Forgot password email recovery flow
description: Verify users can reset their password via a secure email link.
preconditions: User has a registered email address.

steps.action: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and enter registered email.
steps.expectedResult: Confirmation message shown: 'Reset link sent if account exists.'

steps.action: Open the reset email and click the link.
steps.expectedResult: Password reset form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter and confirm a new password meeting complexity requirements.
steps.expectedResult: Password updated; user is redirected to login.

title: Fund transfer to internal account
description: Verify a user can transfer funds between their own accounts within the platform.
preconditions: User has at least two active accounts with sufficient balance.

steps.action: Navigate to Transfer > Internal Transfer.
steps.expectedResult: Transfer form is displayed.

steps.action: Select source account, destination account, and enter amount 500.00.
steps.expectedResult: Transfer summary with fee breakdown is shown.

steps.action: Confirm the transfer.
steps.expectedResult: Success message; both account balances updated immediately.

title: Transfer blocked when balance is insufficient
description: Verify the system prevents transfers that would overdraw the account.
preconditions: Source account balance is less than the requested transfer amount.

steps.action: Attempt to transfer an amount exceeding the current balance.
steps.expectedResult: Error: 'Insufficient funds. Available balance: $X.XX'

steps.action: Verify the account balance remains unchanged.
steps.expectedResult: Account balance is the same as before.

title: International wire transfer with SWIFT code
description: Verify the international wire transfer flow including SWIFT/BIC validation.
preconditions: User account supports international transfers; SWIFT code is valid.

steps.action: Navigate to Transfer > International Wire.
steps.expectedResult: International wire form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter recipient IBAN, SWIFT code, and amount.
steps.expectedResult: FX rate and fee breakdown are shown.

steps.action: Confirm transfer; check status in transaction history.
steps.expectedResult: Transfer status shows 'Processing'; user receives email confirmation.

title: Set up recurring payment schedule
description: Verify users can schedule automatic recurring payments on a defined cadence.
preconditions: User is logged in with an active payment account.

steps.action: Navigate to Payments > Recurring and click New Schedule.
steps.expectedResult: Recurring payment form is displayed.

steps.action: Configure recipient, amount, frequency (monthly), and start date.
steps.expectedResult: Schedule preview shows next three payment dates.

steps.action: Save the schedule; verify it appears in the recurring payments list.
steps.expectedResult: Schedule is listed with correct next-run date.

title: Cancel a pending transfer
description: Verify that a transfer in PENDING state can be cancelled before processing.
preconditions: A transfer is in PENDING status (within cancellation window).

steps.action: Open the pending transfer from transaction history.
steps.expectedResult: Transfer details and Cancel button are shown.

steps.action: Click Cancel and confirm in the dialog.
steps.expectedResult: Transfer status changes to CANCELLED; funds are returned.

title: Account balance displays correctly on dashboard
description: Verify that the dashboard shows the correct real-time balance for all accounts.
preconditions: User has at least one active account.

steps.action: Log in and navigate to the dashboard.
steps.expectedResult: All account cards are displayed with balances.

steps.action: Compare displayed balance against the account ledger via API.
steps.expectedResult: Balance matches the API response to 2 decimal places.

title: Download account statement as PDF
description: Verify the account statement export generates a correctly formatted PDF.
preconditions: Account has at least 5 transactions in the selected date range.

steps.action: Navigate to Account > Statements and select a date range.
steps.expectedResult: Statement preview is rendered.

steps.action: Click Export PDF.
steps.expectedResult: PDF download starts within 3 seconds.

steps.action: Open the PDF and verify transaction count matches the preview.
steps.expectedResult: PDF contains correct transactions, header, and account number.

title: Update billing address
description: Verify users can update their billing address and the change persists.
preconditions: User is logged in.

steps.action: Navigate to Profile > Billing Address and click Edit.
steps.expectedResult: Address form is in editable state.

steps.action: Update address fields and save.
steps.expectedResult: Success toast; new address is displayed.

steps.action: Reload the page and verify the address persisted.
steps.expectedResult: Updated address is shown after page reload.

title: Payment card activation via PIN entry
description: Verify a newly issued card can be activated by setting a PIN.
preconditions: A new physical card has been issued and is in INACTIVE status.

steps.action: Navigate to Cards > Activate Card.
steps.expectedResult: Card activation form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter the last 4 digits of the card and set a 4-digit PIN.
steps.expectedResult: Card status changes to ACTIVE.

steps.action: Verify card appears in active cards list.
steps.expectedResult: Card is listed with ACTIVE badge.

title: Configure daily spending limit
description: Verify users can set and enforce a daily spending limit on their card.
preconditions: User has an active payment card.

steps.action: Navigate to Cards > Spending Limits and set limit to $200/day.
steps.expectedResult: Limit is saved; confirmation shown.

steps.action: Attempt a transaction exceeding the daily limit.
steps.expectedResult: Transaction is declined with 'Daily limit reached' message.

title: Real-time fraud alert triggered on suspicious transaction
description: Verify the fraud detection engine triggers an alert for anomalous transaction patterns.
preconditions: Fraud rules are active; test transaction matches a known fraud pattern.

steps.action: Simulate a transaction from an unusual geographic location via test harness.
steps.expectedResult: Transaction is flagged; push notification sent to user.

steps.action: User confirms the transaction is fraudulent.
steps.expectedResult: Card is temporarily frozen; ticket is created in the fraud queue.

title: KYC document upload and verification
description: Verify users can upload identity documents and the system validates them.
preconditions: User account is pending KYC verification.

steps.action: Navigate to Compliance > KYC and upload a passport image.
steps.expectedResult: Upload progress shown; document queued for review.

steps.action: Verify OCR extraction returns the correct name and date of birth.
steps.expectedResult: Extracted data matches the expected values.

steps.action: Approve the document in the admin panel.
steps.expectedResult: User account status changes to KYC_VERIFIED.

title: AML transaction screening flags high-risk transfers
description: Verify the AML engine screens transactions against sanction lists and blocks matches.
preconditions: Test beneficiary appears on the OFAC sanctions list in test data.

steps.action: Initiate a transfer to a beneficiary on the test sanctions list.
steps.expectedResult: Transfer is blocked; AML alert is raised in the compliance dashboard.

steps.action: Verify the alert contains the matched list name and rule ID.
steps.expectedResult: Alert record contains correct metadata.

title: Audit log captures all fund movement events
description: Verify that every fund transfer creates an immutable audit log entry.
preconditions: Audit log service is active.

steps.action: Complete a fund transfer.
steps.expectedResult: Transfer succeeds.

steps.action: Query the audit log API for the transaction ID.
steps.expectedResult: Log entry contains userId, amount, timestamp, source, and destination.

steps.action: Attempt to delete the audit log entry.
steps.expectedResult: API returns 403 Forbidden — entries are immutable.

title: Account closure request initiates 30-day hold
description: Verify that requesting account closure places a 30-day hold before finalisation.
preconditions: User has a zero balance account.

steps.action: Navigate to Account Settings > Close Account and submit the request.
steps.expectedResult: Confirmation email sent; account status shows 'CLOSURE_PENDING'.

steps.action: Verify the account is still accessible during the 30-day hold.
steps.expectedResult: Read-only access is available; transactions are blocked.

steps.action: After 30 days (simulated), verify account is CLOSED.
steps.expectedResult: Account status is CLOSED; login is rejected with a clear message.
